# Generated files removed during release preparation

28 October 2026 (Asia/Calcutta). Only verified generated project caches/coverage outputs are listed. No product source, test, fixture, documentation, dependency environment, database, screenshot evidence or source archive is removed. No files are moved.

These 173 files (3609909 bytes) were copied to private `.artifacts/release/cleanup-cache-final.zip` and its CRC verified before deletion. The exact local manifest is `.artifacts/release/final-cleanup-manifest.json`. Each removal target is resolved and checked inside the project; no paths outside the project are deleted. Cache directories with unexpected content would be retained.

Reasons: `.pyc`/`__pycache__` are reproducible compiled Python (including obsolete pre-refactor modules); pytest/Ruff directories store generated test/lint state; `.coverage` is binary measurement output. Validation logs/results remain privately recorded. Running tests recreates caches normally. The final validation subprocesses/development reload regenerated 60 of these same bytecode paths (410,952 bytes); they were separately CRC-checked in private `.artifacts/release/cleanup-cache-post-validation.zip` and removed again using the same checked project-boundary procedure. The list counts 173 distinct removed paths, not repeated file instances. `.venv` and its package caches remain untouched.
